evidence_spans.snippet: For linear acceleration the default (factory) 7-bit slave address is 0011001b.
For magnetic sensors the default (factory) 7-bit slave address is 0011110xb.
Table 17. Register address map
CTRL_REG1_A (20h) ... ODR3-0, LPen, Zen, Yen, Xen
CTRL_REG4_A (23h) ... FS1-FS0: Full-scale selection. Default value: 00 (00: +/- 2G)
CRA_REG_M (00h) ... TEMP_EN, DO2-0
CRB_REG_M (01h) ... GN2-0: Gain configuration bits.
MR_REG_M (02h) ... MD1-0: Mode select bits.
LA_So: Linear acceleration sensitivity ... 1 mg/LSB (FS=00)
M_GN: Magnetic gain setting ... 1100 LSB/gauss (GN=001, X,Y)
TSDr: Temperature sensor output change vs. temperature ... 8 LSB/°C
I2C slave timing values ... f(SCL): 0-100 kHz (standard), 0-400 kHz (fast)
Accelerometer operating mode selection ... Normal mode: LPen=0, HR=1
After the start condition (ST) a slave address is sent, once a slave acknowledge (SAK) has been returned, an 8-bit sub-address (SUB) is transmitted
In order to read multiple bytes, it is necessary to assert the most significant bit of the subaddress field.
The address pointer updates automatically without master intervention.
X-axis acceleration data. The value is expressed in 2's complement.
X-axis magnetic field data. The value is expressed as 2's complement.
Temperature data (8LSB/deg - 12-bit resolution). The value is expressed as 2's complement.
STATUS_REG_A (27h) ... ZYXDA: X, Y, and Z axis new data available.
SR_REG_M (09h) ... DRDY: Data ready bit.
Turn-on time [ms] ... Normal mode: 7/ODR
